title: Sales calls → purchase within 90 days
teaser: Reps call accounts they feel are warm; that gut feel isn't recorded.
question: How many extra purchases do we get per 100 sales calls?
ask: Leadership is deciding whether to hire more reps.

treatment.name: got_sales_call
treatment.meaning: 1 = a rep called the account this quarter

outcome.name: purchased_90d
outcome.meaning: 1 = the account bought within 90 days of the quarter start

hidden.name: U_warm
hidden.label: rep's sense the account is warm

notes.text: Reps decide who to call, mostly bigger accounts and ones that bought before.
Reps pick accounts they have a feeling are warm, based on conversations and gut feel. That judgement isn't recorded anywhere.
There was no random element in who got called.

traps.name: Unrecorded gut feel
traps.text: Reps' judgement drives both calls and purchases; not answerable from this file.
